claim: Exact 50-50 binary balance changes the finite-size extremum: no task with fewer than 8 worlds exceeds C_F/C_A=3/2, while an 8-world 5-query task attains 5/3.

symmetry_reduction.query_outcomes: Complementary 0/1 maps are identified because outcome relabeling preserves deterministic resolution costs.
symmetry_reduction.targets: Target assignments are represented by integer multiplicity profiles because the complete balanced-query universe is invariant under world relabeling.
symmetry_reduction.duplicates: Duplicate query partitions add no deterministic information and may only pad declared query count.

minimality.world_count: Exact 50-50 requires even n. n=2 is trivial; complete n=4 and n=6 scans are <=3/2; the n=8 witness is >3/2.
minimality.query_count: For any binary task with m<=4: C_A=1 implies C_F<=1; C_A=2 implies C_F<=3 by the depth-two internal-node bound; C_A>=3 implies C_F/C_A<=4/3. Hence >3/2 requires m>=5.
